title: China's rare-earth technology-export suspension: the reachable layer is separation, metallization and magnet manufacturing outside China, not the miners
map_limitation: Supplier-side EDGAR full-text search, the default discovery motion method 4 prescribes, was weak here and was not the primary method used: the reachable-layer operators are mostly non-US-filer or thin-EDGAR-history issuers (TSX and TSXV for Neo and Ucore, ASX for Lynas and Iluka, TSE for Shin-Etsu and Nidec, Shanghai and Shenzhen for the Chinese incumbents, Euronext for Solvay, and NASDAQ names USAR, ALOY and AREC that are themselves only one to three years past their own IPO or commercial start), so this map leaned on WebFetch of company press releases and trade coverage rather than EDGAR FTS. A genuine departure from the prescribed motion that a future universe pass should correct with real supplier-side EDGAR queries where a US filer exists. Second, the 'non-Chinese' framing is not as clean as general coverage suggests: Shenghe Resources, a Shanghai-listed Chinese producer, holds a 7.7% equity stake in MP Materials plus a Mountain Pass offtake agreement, and industry reporting describes some Southeast Asian 'independent' magnet finishing capacity as machining and coating blanks that were themselves sintered in China; this map could not verify how much of the finishing layer outside China is fully independent versus blank-import-and-finish, and folded finishing into magnet-manufacturing-capacity rather than scoring it as its own link for exactly that reason. Third, quantification is uneven: the automotive exposure figure (IEA, over $3 trillion) is dollar-denominated and dated, while the two most emotionally load-bearing tonnage figures in general coverage, the '920 lbs of rare earths per F-35' and any kg-per-humanoid-robot estimate, both trace to sources this run found undocumented or explicitly unmodeled, so defense and robotics demand are carried as directionally real but deliberately unquantified rather than guessed. Fourth, the largest single non-Chinese magnet-manufacturing capacity addition on this map, Energy Fuels' acquisition of Vacuumschmelze, is signed but not closed (expected early 2027): UUUU is listed on magnet-manufacturing-capacity on the strength of the signed deal, a real but conditional exposure, not yet a consolidated operating fact. Fifth, the chain clock is set to COMPOUNDER rather than the signal's own suggested EVENT tag: the reachable capacity being built here runs on a 2026-2028 construction timeline regardless of the November 10 decision, and the signal's own thesis notes the underlying US-China arrangement is renegotiated annually rather than resolved once; a specific EVENT-clock scenario for the November 10 decision itself belongs at the scenario stage, not the chain level (see notes).

links.name: China's state-anchored mining-to-magnet incumbent complex
links.role: The integrated mining-to-magnet base MOFCOM Announcements 61 and 62 govern: roughly 70% of global rare-earth mining output and up to 90% of global processing capacity sit here, and it is the entity the November 10, 2026 suspension decision is about. It remains the direct supplier of most of the world's civilian rare-earth magnets today, competing with every downstream link on this map for the same buyers even as the decree targets what it may teach them.

bottleneck.note: Gates both the bulk of physical material and, under Decree 62, the transfer of separation, metallization and magnet-manufacturing process technology itself. The constituent producers are exchange-listed on Shanghai and Shenzhen, but foreign retail access runs only through Stock Connect or specialist funds, so listing status and practical investability are two different things here.

capture_inputs.concentration: Roughly 70% of global mining and up to 90% of global processing sit inside one national complex [Korea Times/USGS, as of 2026-03-10; Mining Technology, as of 2026-04-27].
capture_inputs.substitutability: Not substitutable by definition: it is the incumbent every other link on this map is a hedge against.
capture_inputs.margin_posted_by: China Northern Rare Earth's own 2025 profit forecast (up to +135% YoY) shows the incumbent's margin recovering through the suspension window, not eroding [Korea Times, as of 2026-03-10].

explainer.what: זהו כל שרשרת הייצור הסינית של יסודות נדירים, מהכרייה ועד המגנטים המוגמרים, שנמצאת תחת שליטה ממשלתית הדוקה. כאן נולדות ההוראות שקובעות אם טכנולוגיית ההפרדה והמגנטים תצא מסין אל שאר העולם.
explainer.players: חברות ענק בבעלות המדינה הסינית, חלקן נסחרות בבורסות שנחאי ושנזן, אבל הגישה אליהן ממשקיע זר רגיל מוגבלת מאוד ולא דומה לקניית מניה אמריקאית רגילה.
explainer.why: כל עוד ההשעיה של ההגבלות נמשכת, הגוף הזה ממשיך לספק את רוב העולם במגנטים אזרחיים, ולכן הוא בעצם מתחרה בכל שאר החוליות במפה על אותם לקוחות, גם כשההחלטה הבאה שלו יכולה לשנות את זה בבת אחת.
explainer.bottleneck: זו חוליית צוואר הבקבוק המרכזית של כל המפה: היא שולטת גם בחומר עצמו וגם בידע הטכני איך מפרידים ומייצרים ממנו מגנטים, וזו בדיוק הטכנולוגיה שההודעה הסינית מגבילה.
explainer.hands_to: הכרזת ההגבלה שלה היא שמניעה את התגובה הממשלתית המערבית ואת הביקוש הקיים למגנטים אזרחיים בהמשך השרשרת.

links.name: Western government funding, price floors and procurement rules
links.role: The direct policy counter-response to Beijing's decree: DoD, Army and allied-government capital and procurement rules underwriting non-Chinese mining, separation, metal and magnet capacity simultaneously, plus a January 2027 Pentagon sourcing ban that creates guaranteed demand independent of whatever China decides on November 10.

bottleneck.note: Not a supply bottleneck itself but a capital and rules bottleneck: it decides which non-Chinese projects actually get built on schedule. The January 1, 2027 DoD sourcing ban is the one deadline on this map that does not depend on what China does on November 10.

evidence.claim: DoD entered a 10-year agreement establishing a $110/kg price floor for MP Materials' NdPr products, agreed to purchase $400 million of newly-created preferred stock, and the proceeds fund MP's second magnet plant (the 10X Facility), which adds an estimated 10,000 metric tons/year of NdFeB magnet capacity when commissioned in 2028.

DoD agreed to purchase $400 million of a newly-created series of the Company's preferred stock convertible into shares
MP Materials' total U.S. rare earth magnet manufacturing capacity will reach an estimated 10,000 metric tons

capture_inputs.concentration: A handful of government programs, DoD's Industrial Base Analysis and Sustainment office, the Army Contracting Command, and the DoD Title III/DPA channel, are the source of nearly every dollar of Western capacity-building capital named on this map.
capture_inputs.substitutability: Not substitutable from private capital alone at this stage: CSIS's own framing (cited on metal-alloy-production) is that metallization capability takes years of operating history to earn, which is exactly why government price floors and offtake, not equity alone, are what is de-risking construction.
capture_inputs.margin_posted_by: NULL: this link is a policy channel, not a margin-earning operator; margin is posted downstream by the companies it funds.
capture_inputs.note: MP Materials receives DoD backing across mining, separation and magnet manufacturing (the 10X facility) in one deal, so a single MP Materials position already expresses three links on this map at once [MP Materials press release, as of 2025-07-10]. Ticker overlap between this link and the links it funds is intentional, not double counting: it shows where the policy money is actually concentrated, the exact check ARCH-005 in data/chains/_archetypes.md asks for.

explainer.what: זהו הכסף והכללים הממשלתיים המערביים שמנסים לבנות מחדש יכולת ייצור מחוץ לסין: השקעות ישירות, התחייבויות לרכוש בסבלנות ובמחיר קבוע מראש, ותקנות רכש שמחייבות ספק שאינו סיני.
explainer.players: בעיקר גופים ממשלתיים אמריקאיים כמו משרד ההגנה וזרועות הרכש שלו, שמזרימים כסף לאותן חברות שמופיעות בהמשך המפה בשלבי הכרייה, ההפרדה והמגנטים.
explainer.why: בלי הכסף והכללים האלה קשה מאוד למפעל חדש מחוץ לסין להתחרות מול תעשייה סינית ותיקה וזולה יותר, ולכן זו החוליה שקובעת בפועל אילו פרויקטים באמת ייבנו בזמן ואילו יישארו על הנייר.
explainer.bottleneck: זו לא חוליה של מחסור בחומר אלא חוליה של הון וכללים: התקנה שאוסרת על משרד ההגנה לקנות מגנטים ממקור סיני נכנסת לתוקף בתאריך קבוע מראש, בלי קשר להחלטה הסינית עצמה, וזה הופך אותה לוודאות הכי חזקה על כל המפה.
explainer.hands_to: מזרימה תמיכה כמעט לכל חוליית הייצור מלמטה: לכרייה, למיחזור, להפרדה, להפיכה למתכת ולייצור המגנטים עצמם, וגם לביקוש הביטחוני בהמשך.

links.name: Non-China mined rare-earth ore and pre-concentrate (light and heavy)
links.role: The physical raw input outside China's own mines: Mountain Pass (US), Mt Weld and Eneabba mineral sands (Australia), and monazite feed processed through White Mesa (US). This is the layer general coverage already treats as the trade, MP Materials, Lynas, and it is the most crowded, most retail-known part of this whole map.

bottleneck.note: Ore itself is not scarce globally; the constraint is which deposits are permitted, financed and running, not tonnage in the ground. Independence from China is also incomplete here: Shenghe Resources, a Shanghai-listed Chinese producer, holds a 7.7% equity stake in MP Materials plus a long-term Mountain Pass offtake agreement, so the flagship 'non-Chinese' miner already has a Chinese state-linked shareholder and buyer.

evidence.claim: China processes up to 90% of global rare earths, and no single country currently has the financial or technical capacity to replicate China's integrated supply chain, though MP Materials, USA Rare Earth, Lynas Rare Earths and Iluka Resources are named as the firms advancing alternative capacity.
evidence.source_name: Mining Technology, China rare earth export pause nears expiry amid persistent supply concentration
source_excerpt: China processes 'up to 90%' of global rare earths
no single country currently has the financial or technical capacity to replicate China's integrated supply chain

evidence.source_name: rare-earth-mining.com, Chinese Rare Earth Companies: Top 10 Producers 2026
source_excerpt: Its 7.7% equity stake in MP Materials (NYSE: MP), combined with a long-term offtake agreement covering Mountain Pass concentrate

capture_inputs.concentration: A handful of named projects (Mountain Pass, Mt Weld, Eneabba) account for most of the non-Chinese mined tonnage in the fetched sources.
capture_inputs.substitutability: Ore bodies are not interchangeable on light/heavy rare-earth mix: Mountain Pass and Mt Weld are light-rare-earth weighted, which is exactly why the separation and metal links below matter more than mining volume alone.
capture_inputs.margin_posted_by: NULL: no source fetched this run discloses mining-stage margin separately from each company's blended, often loss-making, overall segment result.
capture_inputs.note: Shenghe Resources' stake and offtake mean at least one link in the 'reachable, non-Chinese' story is not cleanly separated from Chinese capital [rare-earth-mining.com, as of 2026-03-27].

explainer.what: זה חומר הגלם עצמו, העפרה שמכילה את יסודות הנדירים, שנכרה מחוץ לסין: במכרות בארצות הברית ובאוסטרליה בעיקר.
explainer.players: החברות המוכרות ביותר לציבור הרחב בכל הסיפור הזה, בדיוק כי הן היו שם ראשונות ומדוברות הכי הרבה בתקשורת הכללית.
explainer.why: זו החוליה שכולם כבר מכירים ועוקבים אחריה, ולכן היא גם הכי פחות מפתיעה מבחינת השקעה: העפרה עצמה קיימת בכמות מספקת בעולם, אז השאלה האמיתית היא מה קורה לה אחרי שהיא יוצאת מהאדמה.
explainer.bottleneck: לא מחסור בכמות אלא שאלה של אישורים, מימון והפעלה בפועל. וגילוי חשוב: לחברה האמריקאית שנחשבת לדוגמה המובילה יש גם שותפה סינית, בעלת מניות ולקוחה בו זמנית, מה שמראה שהפרדה מלאה מסין קשה יותר ממה שנראה על פני השטח.
explainer.hands_to: מעבירה את העפרה הגולמית לשלב ההפרדה, שם היא הופכת ליסודות נפרדים.

links.name: Non-China magnet and secondary-resource recycling
links.role: Post-consumer and production-scrap magnet recycling, the circular pathway Decree 62 names explicitly alongside mining and separation. It is the one feedstock source that structurally cannot be gated by a Chinese export decree, because the material is already outside China by the time it is collected.

bottleneck.note: Small relative to mined tonnage today, but growing on dedicated venture and strategic capital, and at least one named process (magnet-to-magnet routes) skips full chemical separation entirely, a genuine, if narrow, bypass of the separation choke point below.

evidence.claim: Cyclic Materials (private, Canada) closed an oversubscribed $75 million Series C round led by T. Rowe Price with Canada Growth Fund participation, running a two-stage physical and hydrometallurgical process that recovers rare earths from end-of-life magnet scrap sourced from EV motors, wind turbines, MRI machines and data-center e-waste.

capture_inputs.concentration: Three named operators (Cyclic Materials, Noveon Magnetics, ReElement/AREC) account for essentially all of the non-Chinese dedicated recycling capacity in the fetched sources; Noveon and Cyclic are both private.
capture_inputs.substitutability: The feedstock itself is the substitute: recycled scrap routes around the mined-ore chokepoint entirely, though at a small fraction of mined tonnage today.
capture_inputs.margin_posted_by: NULL: Noveon and Cyclic are private with no disclosed margin; AREC does not break out ReElement's recycling-feedstock economics separately in the source fetched this run.

explainer.what: זהו מיחזור מגנטים ישנים ופסולת ייצור, כלומר הפקת יסודות נדירים מחדש ממוצרים שכבר קיימים מחוץ לסין, במקום מכרייה חדשה.
explainer.players: חברות פרטיות קטנות יחסית בצפון אמריקה, חלקן צעירות מאוד, שגייסו לאחרונה סכומי כסף משמעותיים ממשקיעים כדי להרחיב את קווי המיחזור שלהן.
explainer.why: זהו מקור החומר היחיד במפה הזאת שממש אי אפשר לחסום בהכרזה סינית, כי החומר כבר נמצא מחוץ לסין ברגע שהוא נאסף למיחזור.
explainer.bottleneck: כמות קטנה יחסית להיום לעומת הכרייה, אבל בצמיחה מהירה, וחלק מהתהליכים אפילו מדלגים על שלב ההפרדה הכימי המלא ויוצרים סגסוגת ישירות מהפסולת הממוחזרת.
explainer.hands_to: מזינה גם את שלב ההפרדה וגם ישירות את שלב הסגסוגת והמתכת, תלוי באיזה תהליך מיחזור מדובר.

links.name: Non-China rare-earth separation (solvent extraction to individual oxides)
links.role: The exact technology Decree 62 names first: turning mixed rare-earth concentrate into individual oxides (NdPr, Dy, Tb and the rest) by solvent extraction. Neo's Silmet plant, Ucore's Louisiana build, Lynas's DoD-funded Texas heavy-earth line, MP Materials' and Energy Fuels' own trains, and Solvay's long-running La Rochelle site are the confirmed non-Chinese operators.

bottleneck.note: This is the layer the November 10 decision is actually about for the reachable trade. Coverage is more established than a flat 'the whole non-China chain is brand new' framing suggests: Solvay has separated rare earths at La Rochelle since 1948, but even Solvay is only now industrializing the specific heavy magnet-grade oxides (dysprosium, terbium) Decree 62 covers, targeting September 2026, so the operating-history problem is real at the frontier even where a facility itself is old.

evidence.claim: Neo Performance Materials (TSX: NEO) operates the Silmet plant in Estonia, until recently the only industrial-scale rare-earth separation facility operating commercially in the Western hemisphere outside Asia, and its Narva magnet plant targets 2,000 tpa initially, scaling to 5,000 tpa. Ucore Rare Metals (TSXV: UCU) is developing a Strategic Metals Complex in Louisiana using its proprietary RapidSX solvent extraction technology and is not yet an operating refiner at commercial scale.

capture_inputs.concentration: Six confirmed non-Chinese commercial-or-near-commercial operators (Neo, Ucore, Lynas, MP Materials, Energy Fuels, Solvay) against a starting base described as recently as this year as one industrial-scale plant outside Asia [rare-earth-mining.com, as of 2026-08-30].
capture_inputs.substitutability: Not substitutable by a different chemistry at scale: solvent extraction cascades are the proven industrial process; no source fetched this run discloses an alternative running commercially outside China.
capture_inputs.margin_posted_by: NULL: none of the fetched sources discloses separation-stage margin separately from each operator's blended corporate result; MP Materials, Energy Fuels and Solvay all run separation inside larger, diversified companies.
capture_inputs.note: Most of the newly built capacity here is DoD- or Army-funded construction (see western-policy-response), so its economics through a full price cycle are unproven; the operating-history constraint CSIS flags on the next link down applies here too, one stage earlier.

explainer.what: זהו השלב שבו מפרידים את הערבוב הכימי הגולמי ליסודות בודדים ונקיים, כמו ניאודימיום ודיספרוזיום, כל אחד בנפרד. זו בדיוק הטכנולוגיה שההכרזה הסינית אוסרת על ייצוא הידע שלה.
explainer.players: מספר קטן של חברות מחוץ לסין, חלקן ותיקות מאוד וחלקן חדשות לגמרי, שרק בשנים האחרונות התחילו להפריד את היסודות הכבדים והחשובים ביותר בקנה מידה תעשייתי.
explainer.why: זו החוליה שהסיפור הזה באמת נסוב סביבה: מי שיודע להפריד יסודות נדירים מחוץ לסין הוא בדיוק מי שההכרזה הסינית מנסה למנוע ממנו ללמוד את הידע הזה.
explainer.bottleneck: צוואר בקבוק אמיתי: גם כשמפעל קיים כבר עשרות שנים, היכולת הספציפית להפריד את היסודות הכבדים והיקרים ביותר עדיין חדשה מאוד אצל רוב השחקנים, כולל אצל השחקן הוותיק ביותר ברשימה.
explainer.hands_to: מעבירה את היסודות המופרדים והנקיים לשלב הפיכתם למתכת ולסגסוגת.

links.name: Rare-earth metallization and NdFeB alloy production outside China
links.role: Reducing separated oxide to metal and casting it into the NdFeB strip alloy magnet makers actually sinter. CSIS names this, not separation and not magnet sintering, as the single hardest stage to rebuild outside China: an experience-driven metallurgical skill rather than a plant money alone can buy forward. REalloys (Ohio) is named as the only operating North American metallization facility; USA Rare Earth sources its own alloy through its UK subsidiary Less Common Metals.

bottleneck.note: CSIS's own framing: metallization is learned over long operating histories and cannot be recreated on a construction schedule, even fully funded. This is the strongest, most specific choke-point claim on the whole map, and the candidate for this chain's money corner.

evidence.claim: CSIS identifies rare-earth metallization and alloying, converting separated oxide into metal and alloy, as the least developed and most difficult capability to rebuild outside China, an experience-driven bottleneck learned over long operating histories rather than built on a construction schedule. REalloys (Nasdaq: ALOY), based in Euclid, Ohio, is reported as North America's only facility converting heavy rare earths into qualified metals and alloys.
evidence.source_name: PRNewswire, Why Rare Earth Magnets Are the Real Battlefield Between the U.S. and China
source_excerpt: The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) identifies rare-earth metallization and alloying as the least developed and most difficult capability to rebuild outside China.
rare-earth metallization is learned over long operating histories, not built on a schedule
Based in Euclid, Ohio, REalloys (ALOY) operates North America's only facility that has converted heavy rare earths into the high-performance metals and alloys required for defense systems.
No other North American supplier currently produces the same class of qualified heavy rare earth metals and alloys.

evidence.claim: USA Rare Earth (Nasdaq: USAR) commissioned Phase 1a commercial magnet production at its Stillwater, Oklahoma facility on March 26, 2026, enabling customer deliveries of sintered NdFeB magnets from Q2 2026 and targeting a 600 metric-tons/year run rate by Q4 2026; Stillwater sources metal feedstock principally through USAR's UK subsidiary Less Common Metals in Cheshire.
evidence.source_name: rare-earth-mining.com, USA Rare Earth Stillwater: NdFeB Magnet Facility Guide
source_excerpt: Phase 1a of commercial magnet production on 26 March 2026, enabling customer order fulfilment from Q2 2026.
Phase 1a targets 600 MTPA run-rate by Q4 2026
Stillwater sources metal feedstock from third parties, principally through USAR's UK subsidiary Less Common Metals (LCM) in Cheshire.

capture_inputs.concentration: One named operator (REalloys/ALOY) is described as the whole of North American independent metallization capacity outside the vertically integrated operations at Neo and Energy Fuels [PRNewswire, as of 2026-02-27].
capture_inputs.substitutability: The least substitutable stage on the map by the cited evidence: CSIS frames it as experience, not capital, that is scarce, and experience cannot be bought forward on a construction timeline.
capture_inputs.margin_posted_by: NULL: no fetched source discloses metallization-stage margin on its own; REalloys, USA Rare Earth (via LCM) and Neo are all early-stage or blended into larger results in the sources used this run.
capture_inputs.note: NEO.TO and UUUU already appear on rare-earth-separation-capacity: their metallization activity is the same vertically integrated operation, not a second, diversifying bet.

explainer.what: כאן הופכים את החמצן הנפרד למתכת ממשית, ואז לסגסוגת המיוחדת שממנה מכינים בפועל את המגנט. זה שלב מתכתי, לא כימי, וגוף מחקר מוביל מגדיר אותו כשלב הכי קשה לבנות מחדש מחוץ לסין.
explainer.players: מספר קטן במיוחד של חברות, חלקן קטנות מאוד וחלקן חלק מפעולה משולבת רחבה יותר.
explainer.why: לפי הגורם המחקרי שבדק את זה, זו לא שאלה של כסף אלא של ניסיון מצטבר לאורך שנים ארוכות, וניסיון כזה אי אפשר לקנות או לבנות לפי לוח זמנים קבוע.
explainer.bottleneck: זה מועמד חזק להיות הפינה הכי רווחית במפה הזו כולה: מעט מאוד שחקנים יודעים לעשות את זה מחוץ לסין, וגם מי שכבר מממן את זה בכבדות עדיין לא הוכיח רווחיות לאורך זמן.
explainer.hands_to: מעבירה את הסגסוגת המוגמרת לשלב ייצור המגנט עצמו.

links.name: Non-China sintered and bonded NdFeB magnet manufacturing
links.role: Sintering, machining, coating and magnetizing the finished permanent magnet. Neo's Narva line, USA Rare Earth's Stillwater plant (Phase 1a commissioned, first commercial deliveries this year), Shin-Etsu's Vietnam facility, and Energy Fuels' pending acquisition of Vacuumschmelze (not yet closed) are the confirmed non-Chinese names.

bottleneck.note: Decree 62 names magnet manufacturing explicitly. Confirmed non-Chinese sintering capacity is real but young: USA Rare Earth's Stillwater line only began commercial deliveries this year, and Energy Fuels' largest single addition (Vacuumschmelze) will not be consolidated onto a US-listed balance sheet until the acquisition closes in early 2027.

evidence.claim: USA Rare Earth (Nasdaq: USAR) commissioned Phase 1a commercial magnet production at its Stillwater, Oklahoma facility on March 26, 2026, enabling customer deliveries of sintered NdFeB magnets from Q2 2026 and targeting a 600 metric-tons/year run rate by Q4 2026; Stillwater sources metal feedstock principally through USAR's UK subsidiary Less Common Metals in Cheshire.
evidence.source_name: rare-earth-mining.com, USA Rare Earth Stillwater: NdFeB Magnet Facility Guide
source_excerpt: Phase 1a of commercial magnet production on 26 March 2026, enabling customer order fulfilment from Q2 2026.
Phase 1a targets 600 MTPA run-rate by Q4 2026
Stillwater sources metal feedstock from third parties, principally through USAR's UK subsidiary Less Common Metals (LCM) in Cheshire.

VAC operates magnet plants including one in Sumter, South Carolina with 2,000 metric tons/year capacity, expandable to 12,000 metric tons.

capture_inputs.concentration: Confirmed non-Chinese sintering names are still few relative to Chinese output: Neo, USA Rare Earth, Shin-Etsu, and a pending Energy Fuels / Vacuumschmelze combination are what this run could confirm as independently operating or contractually committed.
capture_inputs.substitutability: Sintered NdFeB is not easily substituted for high-performance applications (EV traction, defense-grade), though ferrite and bonded alternatives exist at the low-performance end; see the demand links for where rare-earth-free motor design is already eroding addressable demand.
capture_inputs.margin_posted_by: NULL: no fetched source discloses magnet-manufacturing margin separately from each company's blended result, and the largest single non-Chinese capacity add (Vacuumschmelze, via Energy Fuels) is not yet on a public balance sheet.
capture_inputs.note: NEO.TO and UUUU already appear upstream on separation and metal-alloy: the same vertically integrated operator, not new diversification. USAR appears on metal-alloy via its LCM subsidiary and here via Stillwater: also one bet, not two.

explainer.what: זהו שלב הכנת המגנט המוגמר בפועל: עיצוב, חימום, וגימור פני השטח כדי שהמגנט יהיה מוכן להתקנה במנוע או בטורבינה.
explainer.players: כמה חברות מחוץ לסין, כולל אחת יפנית ותיקה מאוד וכמה אמריקאיות וקנדיות צעירות יותר, ועוד עסקת רכישה גדולה שנחתמה אך טרם הושלמה בפועל.
explainer.why: זו החוליה שהצרכן הסופי, מהיצרן הביטחוני ועד יצרן הרכב החשמלי, בסוף פונה אליה, ולכן היא נקודת המפגש בין כל שלבי הייצור לבין הביקוש בפועל.
explainer.bottleneck: אמיתי אך צעיר: קו הייצור האמריקאי המרכזי רק החל לספק ללקוחות ממש השנה, וההרחבה הגדולה ביותר עדיין תלויה בהשלמת עסקת רכישה שלא נסגרה.
explainer.hands_to: מספקת מגנטים מוגמרים לכל ענפי הביקוש: רכב חשמלי, טורבינות רוח, מערכות ביטחוניות, ואלקטרוניקה ורובוטיקה.

links.name: EV and automotive traction-motor OEM demand
links.role: The single largest dollar exposure named in the fetched literature: IEA puts automotive at over $3 trillion of potential direct losses outside China if controls were implemented in full, more than every other downstream sector combined. Motor makers are also the demand-side actor actively engineering around rare-earth exposure, which is this link's real capture ceiling.

bottleneck.note: Demand is enormous but diffuse across many motor architectures, and the demand-side response to scarcity is substitution, not price acceptance: Nidec's own second-generation E-Axle already cuts heavy rare-earth (dysprosium, terbium) content through better thermal design, and the company states it plans to keep reducing further.

evidence.claim: If China's rare earth export controls were implemented in full, the economic value of downstream production at risk would reach USD 6.5 trillion per year for countries outside China, with the automotive sector facing the single greatest impact at over USD 3 trillion in potential direct losses, followed by electronics and other transport.
evidence.source_name: International Energy Agency, Global Critical Minerals Outlook (Rare Earth Elements analysis)
source_excerpt: If these rare earth export controls were implemented in full, the economic value of downstream production at risk would reach USD 6.5 trillion per year for countries outside China.

The automotive sector is set to face the single greatest impact with over USD 3 trillion in potential direct losses outside China, followed by electronics and other transport (aviation, trucks and trains) sectors.

evidence.claim: Nidec's second-generation E-Axle traction motor system uses magnets requiring significantly less dysprosium and terbium (heavy rare earths), achieved through an improved two-way oil-circulation cooling system that lowers magnet temperature so less heavy-rare-earth heat-resistance doping is needed.
evidence.source_name: Nidec Corporation, press release: Nidec Launches Mass Production of Its Second-generation EV Traction Motor System
source_excerpt: Use of magnets that require significantly less amounts of dysprosium (Dy), terbium (Tb), and other kinds of heavy rare earth thanks to the improved cooling capability based on the newly developed two-way oil-circulation system.

capture_inputs.concentration: Diffuse: no single motor maker dominates global EV/auto traction-motor supply the way separation or metallization is concentrated upstream.
capture_inputs.substitutability: The most substitutable link on the demand side by the cited evidence: Nidec's own second-generation E-Axle already cuts heavy rare-earth content through thermal design alone [Nidec press release, as of 2022-10-24], and induction or switched-reluctance motor designs exist as further, more radical substitutes this map does not separately score. This is the real ceiling on pricing power for every upstream link.
capture_inputs.margin_posted_by: NULL: motor-stage margin is not disclosed separately from each OEM's broader automotive or components segment in any source fetched this run.

explainer.what: זהו הביקוש למגנטים ממנועי רכב חשמלי ורכב מודרני בכלל, החוליה עם החשיפה הכספית הגדולה ביותר מכל הענפים שנבדקו.
explainer.players: יצרני מנועים ורכיבי הנעה גדולים ומגוונים, שהמגנטים הם רק חלק אחד מהעסק הרחב שלהם.
explainer.why: גוף אנרגיה בינלאומי מוביל מעריך שהחשיפה הכספית של ענף הרכב לבדו, אם ההגבלות הסיניות היו מיושמות במלואן, גבוהה יותר מכל שאר הענפים גם יחד.
explainer.bottleneck: בינוני, כי הביקוש עצום אבל מפוזר על פני הרבה סוגי מנועים, ובעיקר כי יצרני המנועים עצמם עובדים באופן פעיל על הקטנת התלות ביסודות הנדירים הכבדים, לא רק על קנייתם.
explainer.hands_to: סוף השרשרת: אין חוליה נוספת אחריה במפה הזו.

links.name: Wind turbine permanent-magnet generator demand
links.role: Direct-drive offshore wind turbines carry the heaviest rare-earth-magnet loading of any mainstream application; geared designs carry much less by deliberate choice. IEA's downstream-exposure figure names electrification broadly, of which wind generation is a component.

bottleneck.note: Real but not universal: manufacturers make an explicit design choice between direct-drive (high magnet content) and geared (much lower) drivetrains, so the sector's aggregate rare-earth exposure depends on a mix the fetched source describes as shifting, not fixed.

evidence.claim: A reasonable current baseline is about 0.15 tons of rare-earth magnet material per MW of wind turbine capacity; roughly two-thirds of permanent-magnet generators in one analyst's dataset use direct-drive (higher magnet content), some retain gears specifically to cut rare-earth content by up to 90%, and Vestas is now using rare earth elements in all its new grid-scale turbine models.
evidence.source_name: Thunder Said Energy, Wind turbine generators: DFIGs or Rare Earth magnets?
source_excerpt: a good baseline today is perhaps 0.15 tons/MW
About two-thirds of the PMSGs in our data-file use direct drive
Some PMSGs retain gears in order to lower the amount of Rare Earth materials/magnets required by up 90%.
now using Rare Earth elements in all new grid turbine models

capture_inputs.concentration: GEV and ENR.DE already recur as money-corner or near-money-corner names in other Upstream chains (ai-infrastructure's power-equipment, tibet-mega-dam's uhvdc-transmission) [ARCH-005, data/chains/_archetypes.md]: a wind-turbine-demand position in either name is a second expression of a bet already held, not new diversification, for anyone already holding it there.
capture_inputs.substitutability: Turbine makers actively choose between direct-drive (high magnet content) and geared (up to roughly 90% less, per the cited source) drivetrains, so aggregate sector exposure is a design mix, not a fixed multiplier.
capture_inputs.margin_posted_by: NULL: no source fetched this run discloses the magnet-content share of turbine generator margin specifically.

explainer.what: זהו הביקוש למגנטים ממחוללים בטורבינות רוח, בעיקר בטורבינות ימיות שמתוכננות בלי גיר, שם כמות המגנט הנדרשת גבוהה במיוחד.
explainer.players: יצרני טורבינות רוח גדולים, כולל כמה שכבר מופיעים במפות אחרות של אפסטרים בהקשרים אחרים לגמרי.
explainer.why: יצרן טורבינות מוביל מעריך כמות מגנט לכל יחידת הספק, ולפי אותו מקור רוב הטורבינות כיום מתוכננות דווקא בלי גיר, כלומר עם כמות המגנט הגבוהה יותר.
explainer.bottleneck: אמיתי אך לא אחיד: היצרנים בוחרים באופן מודע בין עיצוב עם גיר לעיצוב בלי גיר, וההבדל בכמות המגנט הנדרשת ביניהם משמעותי מאוד, כך שהחשיפה הכוללת של הענף תלויה בתמהיל הזה.
explainer.hands_to: סוף השרשרת: אין חוליה נוספת אחריה במפה הזו.

links.name: Defense and precision-guidance magnet demand
links.role: The one demand link with a hard, dated deadline of its own: a DoD final rule bars magnets (NdFeB and samarium-cobalt), tantalum and tungsten mined, refined, separated, melted or produced in China, Russia, Iran or North Korea from federal procurement starting January 1, 2027, a deadline that does not depend on what Beijing decides on November 10. The commonly cited '920 pounds of rare earths per F-35' figure traces to a single unreleased 2012 DoD study with no published methodology, so this map states the deadline as the driver and declines to quantify defense-sector tonnage.

bottleneck.note: The January 2027 DoD sourcing ban is a compliance deadline, not a market one: it forces every prime and sub touching a covered platform to prove a non-China chain of custody from mine to magnet by that date, which is exactly the reachable non-China layer this map is built around.

evidence.claim: A DoD final rule implementing NDAA Section 844 (FY21) and Section 854 (FY24) bars samarium-cobalt and neodymium-iron-boron magnets, tantalum and tungsten from federal procurement if any stage (mined, refined, separated, melted or produced) occurred in China, Russia, Iran or North Korea, effective January 1, 2027.
evidence.source_name: Crowell & Moring LLP, client alert: DoD Expands Restrictions on Supply Chain for Certain Magnets, Tantalum, and Tungsten
source_excerpt: samarium-cobalt magnets, tantalum metals and alloys, tungsten metal powder, and tungsten heavy alloy
Iran, North Korea, Russia, and China
mined, refined, separated, melted or produced in one of the covered countries
January 1, 2027

evidence.claim: The widely repeated claim that an F-35 contains about 920 lbs (417 kg) of rare earth materials traces to a single, never publicly released September 2012 DoD internal study on REE recycling feasibility, with no methodology, bill-of-materials breakdown, supporting data tables or raw calculations ever disclosed.
evidence.source_name: Adamas Intelligence, How Much Rare Earths Does an F-35 Really Contain?
source_excerpt: each F-35 Lightning II requires approximately 920 lbs (≈417 kg) of rare earth materials. The figure originates from a single September 2012 Department of Defense internal study on REE recycling feasibility that was submitted to Congress but has never been publicly released.
No methodology, no bill-of-materials breakdown, no supporting data tables and no raw calculations have ever been disclosed.

capture_inputs.concentration: Diversified defense primes (Lockheed Martin, RTX) rather than pure-plays; cross-reference munitions-replenishment's dod-munitions-procurement link, which the archetype library already records as the 'uninvestable order-book owner' pattern (ARCH-003): the buyer, not a trade.
capture_inputs.substitutability: NULL: no fetched source discloses how substitutable rare-earth magnets are inside classified or export-controlled defense platforms specifically.
capture_inputs.margin_posted_by: NULL: defense primes do not break out magnet-content margin, and the 920 lb F-35 figure this map declines to use would not have supported a margin calculation even at face value.

explainer.what: זהו הביקוש למגנטים ממכשירי אלקטרוניקה צריכתית ומרובוטיקה, כולל רובוטים הומנואידיים, ענף שגדל מהר אבל עדיין קשה לכמת אותו בטונות.
explainer.players: החוליה הזו במכוון לא מפרטת חברות ספציפיות, כי מפה אחרת באותה מערכת כבר עוסקת ישירות בדיוק בביקוש הזה מזווית הרובוטיקה.
explainer.why: גוף אנרגיה בינלאומי מוביל מונה אלקטרוניקה כאחד הענפים החשופים, לצד רכב, וגם דיווח מקצועי שנבדק מציין שלכל רובוט הומנואידי יש עשרות מפעילים קטנים שכל אחד מהם צורך מגנט משלו.
explainer.bottleneck: אמיתי בכיוון, לא בכמות: אין עדיין מודל אמין שמתרגם מספר רובוטים לכמות מגנט בפועל, ולכן החוליה נשארת מכוונת אך לא מכומתת, בכוונה תחילה.
explainer.hands_to: סוף השרשרת: אין חוליה נוספת אחריה במפה הזו.

notes.text: Chain clock set to COMPOUNDER over the signal's own suggested EVENT tag. Justification: horizon_years on SIG-20260901-02 is 2 to 4 years, the signal's own thesis states the underlying US-China rare-earth arrangement is renegotiated annually rather than resolved in one pass ('Trump has described the underlying US-China arrangement as renegotiated annually rather than a one-off'), and the actual investable layer this map targets (separation, metallization, magnet capacity) runs on a 2026-2028 construction timeline that does not depend on the November 10 decision alone. The November 10 decree decision itself is EVENT-shaped and belongs as a scenario inside this chain at the run scenarios stage, not as the chain's own clock, per method section 2's own worked example: 'the AI build-out is COMPOUNDER; a specific export-control ruling inside it is EVENT.'

Archetypes checked against _archetypes.md before drawing this map, per the log's own instruction to check whether a chain is an instance of one already mapped. ARCH-006 (geopolitical counter-response as a first-class link) applied directly: western-policy-response is wired in as a second topological root exactly as the library describes, and it produced this chain's largest evidence base and its single hardest deadline (the DoD 2027-01-01 sourcing rule), consistent with the library's flag that this archetype's one prior instance (tibet-mega-dam/global-hydro-spillover) was the corpus's best link; recurrence now stands at 2 of 4 chains built since the archetype hardened. ARCH-004 (critical material input, criticality set by substitutability times logistics) applied across every material-stage link; the substitutability half is unusually well evidenced here because motor makers are actively engineering rare earths out (Nidec's own cooling redesign), recorded in capture_inputs on the demand links rather than invented as a score. ARCH-003 (uninvestable order-book owner) applied partially to defense-precision-guidance-demand, cross-referenced to munitions-replenishment's dod-munitions-procurement rather than re-derived. ARCH-005 (power and grid equipment behind someone else's story) checked and fires on wind-turbine-generator-demand: GEV and ENR.DE both recur from ai-infrastructure and tibet-mega-dam, flagged in that link's capture_inputs per the library's own instruction to check for a second expression of one bet. ARCH-001 (precision manufacturing capacity as the gating step) and ARCH-002 (EPC/civil-contractor trap) checked for fit and do not apply: no link here is a tooling-capacity gate or a competitively bid construction trade in the cited evidence; the closest candidate, metal-alloy-production, is CSIS-framed as an experience bottleneck rather than a tooling-capacity one, which is ARCH-001-adjacent but not the same claim, so it was not forced into that archetype. ARCH-007 (semis as a leaf in someone else's chain) does not apply; this chain has no semiconductor link. No new archetype proposed this run.

This map resolves both open gaps SIG-20260901-02's own retail_gap field named as unresolved. Vacuumschmelze: not independent and not yet on any public balance sheet; Energy Fuels (NYSE American: UUUU) agreed to acquire it for approximately $1.9 billion on 2026-06-23, closing expected early 2027, so it is carried here as a real but conditional exposure on magnet-manufacturing-capacity, not yet a consolidated operating fact. Solvay: resolved and undersold by the signal's own prior research pass; Solvay (Euronext: SOLB) has separated rare earths at its La Rochelle, France plant since 1948, is one of the largest such sites outside China, and is targeting industrial-scale dysprosium and terbium separation by September 2026 with a Brazil feedstock partnership (Viridis) behind it. Both facts were found this run via WebFetch of the companies' own press releases and neither required an EDGAR query, itself evidence for this map's map_limitation finding that supplier-side EDGAR search is not the effective discovery motion for this particular chain.

explainer.shape: המפה הזאת בנויה כתהליך: מהמכרה והפסולת הממוחזרת, דרך ההפרדה לחמצנים בודדים, דרך הפיכת החמצן למתכת וסגסוגת, ועד הרכבת המגנט המוגמר שנכנס למנוע או לטורבינה. במקביל יש שני שורשים נוספים: הגוף הסיני עצמו, שהוא מקור הבעיה, והתגובה הממשלתית המערבית, שמממנת כמעט כל בנייה של יכולת חלופית.
explainer.thesis: הכותרות מתמקדות בכרייה ובהחלטה הסינית הקרובה, אבל השלב שבאמת קובע מי מרוויח הוא לא הכרייה ולא ההכרזה עצמה, אלא מי מסוגל להפוך עפרה לחמצן נפרד, את החמצן למתכת, ואת המתכת למגנט, מחוץ לסין. זה בדיוק השלב שההכרזות הסיניות אוסרות על העברת הידע אליו, וזה בדיוק השלב שהכי מעט חברות בעולם יודעות לעשות היום.
